headline: Eastern Naval Command Conducts Coastal Security Exercise 'Sagar Kavach' Off AP Coast
summary: The Indian Navy's Eastern Naval Command, in coordination with the Andhra Pradesh Police, Coast Guard, and marine fisheries departments, successfully concluded the two-day coastal security exercise 'Sagar Kavach'. The drill simulated multi-layered security threats along the state's 974-kilometer coastline to test operational readiness and inter-agency coordination. Special focus was laid on securing vital installations and monitoring unlit fishing vessels.
keyFacts: Exercise 'Sagar Kavach' conducted off AP coast
Coordinated by Eastern Naval Command, AP Police, and Coast Guard
Tests security readiness across AP's 974-km coastline
examRelevance: Crucial for security preparedness, defense exercises, and APPSC regional security topics.

headline: NITI Aayog Releases State Multidimensional Poverty Index 2026 Report
summary: NITI Aayog released the latest State Multidimensional Poverty Index report, indicating a sharp decline in poverty rates across India over the past five years. Kerala, Goa, and Tamil Nadu registered the lowest poverty incidence, while several central and eastern states showed remarkable improvement due to targeted welfare transfers. The index tracks deprivations across health, education, and standard of living indicators.
keyFacts: Released by NITI Aayog
Tracks health, education, and standard of living indicators
Kerala, Goa, and Tamil Nadu rank lowest in poverty incidence
examRelevance: Extremely important for economic development, social welfare indices, and UPSC/State PSC exams.

headline: International Day of Climate Action Observed Worldwide with Focus on Urban Resilience
summary: Nations across the globe observed the International Day of Climate Action with seminars, youth rallies, and policy roundtables focusing on urban climate resilience. The United Nations Environment Programme released a special report emphasizing the vulnerability of coastal mega-cities to rising sea levels. Cities worldwide pledged enhanced investments in nature-based urban drainage and green infrastructure solutions.
keyFacts: Observed worldwide as International Day of Climate Action
UNEP released special report on coastal mega-cities vulnerability
Focuses on nature-based urban drainage and green infrastructure
examRelevance: Useful for environment days, themes, and global ecological commitments.

headline: Andhra Pradesh High Court Inaugurates Paperless E-Court System Across All Districts
summary: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh has officially transitioned all subordinate and district courts to a fully paperless e-court system. Litigants and advocates can now file documents digitally, track case hearings in real-time through mobile applications, and access judgment copies instantly via secured cloud servers. This digital overhaul aims to eliminate procedural delays and enhance judicial transparency.
keyFacts: Transitioned all district and subordinate courts to paperless e-court system
Enables digital filing and real-time case tracking
Aims to eliminate procedural delays and enhance transparency
examRelevance: Relevant for judicial reforms, e-governance, and state legal updates in APPSC exams.

headline: India Hosts Global Organic Agriculture and Millet Conclave in New Delhi
summary: Prime Minister inaugurated the Global Organic Agriculture and Millet Conclave in New Delhi, bringing together agricultural scientists, policymakers, and international delegations. The three-day conclave highlighted India's leadership in climate-resilient farming and the promotion of nutri-cereals. A new international research consortium was established to enhance millet seed varieties and organic farming yields.
keyFacts: Inaugurated in New Delhi
Focuses on organic farming and nutri-cereals (millets)
Establishes an international research consortium for millet seeds
examRelevance: Important for agriculture, food security, and government summit questions in competitive exams.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Forest Department Launches 'Green Corridors' Initiative in Eastern Ghats
summary: The Andhra Pradesh Forest Department has initiated the 'Green Corridors' project across the Eastern Ghats to protect endangered endemic flora and fauna. The initiative establishes protected ecological pathways between reserve forests in Visakhapatnam and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts to mitigate human-wildlife conflict. Community-based eco-tourism programs are also being launched alongside forest conservation efforts.
keyFacts: Launched by AP Forest Department in Eastern Ghats
Connects reserve forests across Visakhapatnam and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts
Aims to mitigate human-wildlife conflict and promote eco-tourism
examRelevance: Important for APPSC environment and geography questions regarding state wildlife conservation.

headline: International Olympic Committee Confirms Cricket Inclusion Format for 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
summary: The International Olympic Committee executive board has officially ratified the T20 cricket format for men's and women's competitions at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games. The tournament will feature six teams in each category, determined through global qualifying rankings and host nation quotas. This milestone marks cricket's return to the Olympic arena after a gap of over a century since Paris 1900.
keyFacts: Ratified by International Olympic Committee (IOC)
T20 format chosen for men and women at LA 2028 Olympics
Six teams per category with global qualifying rankings
examRelevance: High relevance for sports current affairs and Olympic history questions in competitive exams.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department Celebrates 'Lepakshi Heritage Festival'
summary: The Andhra Pradesh Department of Culture and Tourism successfully hosted the annual 'Lepakshi Heritage Festival' in Sri Sathya Sai district. The three-day cultural extravaganza showcased classical dance performances, traditional handicrafts, and historical exhibitions celebrating the architectural legacy of the Vijayanagara Empire. The event aims to boost cultural tourism and promote local artisan communities on the global stage.
keyFacts: Hosted annually at Lepakshi in Sri Sathya Sai district
Celebrates the architectural legacy of the Vijayanagara Empire
Organized by AP Department of Culture and Tourism
examRelevance: Important for APPSC questions on state festivals, history, art, and tourism heritage.

headline: Ministry of Agriculture Expands PM-KISAN Portal with AI-Powered Crop Health Advisor
summary: The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare has integrated an AI-powered Crop Health Advisor into the PM-KISAN digital portal. The new feature provides personalized crop advisories, weather warnings, and pest management solutions to over 110 million registered farmers in local languages. The tool utilizes satellite imagery and real-time IoT soil sensor data to generate accurate recommendations.
keyFacts: Integrated into PM-KISAN digital portal
Offers AI-driven advisory in local languages
Uses satellite imagery and IoT soil sensor data
examRelevance: Essential for questions on central government welfare schemes, digital agriculture, and rural development.

headline: IMF Releases World Economic Outlook Proposing Global Financial Resilience Measures
summary: The International Monetary Fund released its latest World Economic Outlook report in Washington, revising global growth projections for 2026 downward to 2.8% due to persistent geopolitical tensions. The report emphasizes the need for central banks to maintain calibrated monetary tightening and calls for robust debt restructuring frameworks for low-income countries. It also highlights the growing economic integration of South Asian digital payment systems.
keyFacts: Released by the International Monetary Fund (IMF)
Revises global growth projection for 2026 to 2.8%
Highlights South Asian digital payment systems integration
examRelevance: Crucial for economic surveys, global indices, and international economic affairs questions.

headline: BRICS Summit in Rio de Janeiro Adopts Common Financial Settlement Framework
summary: The annual BRICS Summit concluded in Rio de Janeiro with member nations adopting a common financial settlement framework designed to facilitate trade in local currencies. The bloc also formally welcomed three new dialogue partner nations from Latin America and Africa. Leaders emphasized multilateralism, reform of global financial governance bodies, and equitable access to green energy technologies.
keyFacts: Hosted in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Adopts common financial settlement framework for local currency trade
Welcomes new dialogue partner nations
examRelevance: Vital for international relations, multilateral groupings (BRICS), and global economic governance.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Establishes State-of-the-Art Genome Sequencing Hub in Visakhapatnam
summary: The Andhra Pradesh government inaugurated a specialized Genome Sequencing Hub at the Andhra Medical College campus in Visakhapatnam. Funded under the National Health Mission, the facility will monitor emerging viral mutations, track pathogen transmission, and aid precision medicine research. It serves as a regional diagnostic anchor for coastal Andhra and neighboring districts.
keyFacts: Located at Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam
Funded under the National Health Mission
Designed for pathogen tracking and precision medicine
examRelevance: Important for APPSC exams covering healthcare infrastructure, medical advancements, and public health initiatives.

headline: Indian Navy Commissions Third Stealth Destroyer INS Imphal under Project 15B
summary: The Indian Navy formally commissioned INS Imphal, the third stealth guided-missile destroyer under Project 15B, at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai. Built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited, the warship boasts over 75% indigenous content, including advanced electronic warfare suites and supersonic BrahMos missiles. This addition significantly enhances India's maritime strike capabilities in the Indo-Pacific region.
keyFacts: Third stealth guided-missile destroyer under Project 15B
Built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited
Features over 75% indigenous content and BrahMos missiles
examRelevance: Critical for defense updates, national security, and current affairs in UPSC and defense examinations.

headline: AP Government Rolls Out 'Vidya Vikasam' Scheme for Skill-Based Learning in Schools
summary: The Andhra Pradesh government has launched the 'Vidya Vikasam' scheme to integrate vocational training and skill-based learning into the secondary school curriculum. The program partners with leading global technology firms to set up smart labs and coding centers across government high schools. It seeks to bridge the employability gap and empower students with futuristic technical competencies.
keyFacts: Introduced as 'Vidya Vikasam' scheme
Integrates vocational training and coding centers in government schools
Aims to bridge the employability gap for students
examRelevance: Highly relevant for APPSC Group 1 and Group 2 exams focusing on educational reforms in the state.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Signs MoU with Global Renewable Energy Giants for Green Hydrogen Hub
summary: The Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board has signed memorandums of understanding with major global green energy corporations to establish a multi-billion dollar Green Hydrogen Hub in Krishnapatnam. The project is projected to generate over 15,000 direct jobs and produce green hydrogen for both domestic industrial use and European export markets. The state government has offered attractive fiscal incentives under the AP Clean Energy Policy 2026.
keyFacts: Green Hydrogen Hub signed for Krishnapatnam
Projects over 15,000 direct jobs
Backed by AP Clean Energy Policy 2026
examRelevance: Crucial for APPSC economics, industrial growth, and sustainable energy investments in the state.

headline: Reserve Bank of India Introduces Unified Green Credit Platform for Banks
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has rolled out a unified Green Credit Platform to streamline financing for environmentally sustainable projects across the banking sector. Under this framework, commercial banks are mandated to allocate a specific percentage of their priority sector lending towards certified green initiatives. The move supports India's long-term commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2070.
keyFacts: Rolled out by the Reserve Bank of India
Mandates green project financing under priority sector lending
Aims to support India's net-zero 2070 target
examRelevance: Vital for banking exams (RBI Grade B, SBI/IBPS) and UPSC questions on sustainable finance and monetary policies.

headline: UGC Announces Guidelines for Joint Degree Programs Between Indian and Foreign Universities
summary: The University Grants Commission has released comprehensive guidelines allowing top-ranked Indian higher educational institutions to offer joint and dual degree programs with globally recognized foreign universities. Under the framework, credits earned abroad will be seamlessly transferred through the Academic Bank of Credits. This policy aims to internationalize Indian higher education and reduce the outflow of student capital.
keyFacts: Released by University Grants Commission (UGC)
Permits joint and dual degrees with foreign universities
Uses Academic Bank of Credits for credit transfer
examRelevance: Important for higher education policies, academic reforms, and UPSC governance questions.

headline: India and Japan Sign Comprehensive Digital Partnership Treaty in Tokyo
summary: India and Japan have signed a landmark Comprehensive Digital Partnership Treaty during the bilateral summit held in Tokyo. The agreement aims to enhance cooperation in critical technologies such as artificial intelligence, semiconductor supply chain resilience, and cross-border data governance. Both nations agreed to establish a joint innovation fund worth $1 billion to support tech startups.
keyFacts: Signed in Tokyo during bilateral summit
Focuses on AI and semiconductor supply chain resilience
Establishes a joint innovation fund worth $1 billion
examRelevance: Essential for UPSC and competitive exams covering India's bilateral relations and tech diplomacy.

headline: UN Climate Summit Adopts Global Ocean Biodiversity Protection Treaty in Geneva
summary: Delegates at the UN Climate Summit in Geneva have formally adopted the Global Ocean Biodiversity Protection Treaty after years of rigorous negotiations. The legally binding pact sets a target to protect at least 35% of international waters as marine protected areas by 2035. Developing nations will receive financial assistance from a dedicated global fund to combat illegal fishing and marine pollution.
keyFacts: Adopted at the UN Climate Summit in Geneva
Sets target to protect 35% of international waters by 2035
Establishes a dedicated global fund for developing nations
examRelevance: Essential for environment, ecology, and international conventions topics in competitive exams.

headline: Andhra Pradesh Government Launches Mega Aqua Hub Initiative in West Godavari
summary: The Government of Andhra Pradesh has officially inaugurated the state-of-the-art Mega Aqua Hub in West Godavari district to boost the marine and aquaculture export ecosystem. The facility provides advanced cold-chain storage, quality testing laboratories, and direct market linkage for local aqua farmers. This initiative aligns with the state's vision to increase seafood exports and double farmers' incomes over the next five years.
keyFacts: Inaugurated in West Godavari district
Features advanced cold-chain storage and testing labs
Aims to boost marine exports and aqua farmers' incomes
examRelevance: Crucial for APPSC exams regarding state agricultural schemes, aquaculture developments, and rural economy.

headline: NASA Successfully Tests Nuclear Thermal Propulsion Rocket Engine for Deep Space Missions
summary: NASA has successfully conducted a ground test of its advanced Nuclear Thermal Propulsion (NTP) rocket engine, marking a significant breakthrough for crewed Mars missions. The nuclear engine provides twice the fuel efficiency of conventional chemical rockets, drastically cutting travel time to the Red Planet. The technology is slated for uncrewed orbital flight testing by the end of the decade.
keyFacts: Tested by NASA
Nuclear Thermal Propulsion (NTP) engine offers double fuel efficiency
Designed to cut travel time for crewed Mars missions
examRelevance: Relevant for science and technology updates in global current affairs.

headline: ISRO Successfully Launches Advanced Earth Observation Satellite EOS-09
summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully launched the EOS-09 advanced earth observation satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota using the PSLV-C60 vehicle. This satellite is equipped with high-resolution hyperspectral imaging sensors designed to monitor agricultural yields, forest cover, and disaster management across the country. The mission further strengthens India's orbital capabilities for environmental monitoring and climate change tracking.
keyFacts: Launched via PSLV-C60
Carries high-resolution hyperspectral imaging sensors
Lifted off from Satish Dhawan Space Centre
examRelevance: Important for questions on ISRO missions, space tech, and remote sensing applications.

headline: Parliament Passes the National Digital Governance and Data Protection Framework Act
summary: The Parliament of India has enacted the National Digital Governance and Data Protection Framework Act to establish uniform protocols for e-governance service delivery. The legislation mandates all central and state departments to adopt interoperable digital public infrastructure by the end of 2027. It also strengthens citizen grievance redressal mechanisms through an automated AI-driven grievance tracking portal.
keyFacts: Enacted by the Parliament of India
Mandates interoperable digital public infrastructure by 2027
Introduces an automated AI-driven grievance portal
examRelevance: Important for polity, governance, and e-governance questions in civil services examinations.

headline: Government Appoints New Chief Economic Adviser and Cabinet Secretary
summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet has announced the appointment of senior economist Dr. Alok Mishra as the new Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India. Simultaneously, veteran bureaucrat Rajesh Verma took charge as the new Cabinet Secretary, succeeding the previous incumbent. These high-level administrative appointments are aimed at steering key economic reforms and administrative execution.
keyFacts: Dr. Alok Mishra appointed Chief Economic Adviser
Rajesh Verma appointed Cabinet Secretary
Approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet
examRelevance: Essential for questions on key bureaucratic appointments and top government functionaries.
